lesson_evidence.target: I can find a percent of a quantity or an unknown whole from a part-to-whole model.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Percent work is review/partial ES-03; integrated proportional-context proficiency extends later.

lesson_evidence.target: I can list or tabulate all ordered outcomes of two simple experiments.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Independent evidence after instruction, practice, and feedback.

lesson_evidence.target: I can compute probabilities of single and two-stage events, explaining favorable and total outcomes.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Independent evidence after instruction, practice, and feedback.

lesson_evidence.target: I can use a complete tree/table to justify compound-event probabilities with and without replacement.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: Context and denominators matter; model unequal likelihood rather than assuming equally likely colors.

lesson_evidence.target: I can define an unknown, organize data, and write an equation that models a word problem.
lesson_evidence.evidence_note: This chapter establishes models and variable meaning; formal independent algebraic solving belongs in Chapter 6.

assessment_design.practice: select direct plus spiral families and current chapter target
assessment_design.quick_check: use concise independent reasoning + direct items from taught targets, do not infer full rung from partial evidence
assessment_design.checkpoint: select at least two distinct current targets; include explanation and recheck opportunity
assessment_design.test: sample taught chapter evidence plus earlier rechecks; report full proficiency only at appropriate EXPECT stage
assessment_design.custom: assemble authored bank exemplars and existing source cards
assessment_design.feedback_recheck: use a fresh parallel task after feedback rather than repeating exact data

pilot_policy.mastery_rule: FIRST_CHECK, READINESS and PARTIAL never automatically equal Proficient.
